adjudication.rationale: The migration `db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb` builds raw SQL with `execute "... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"` where `h` comes directly from the legacy `site_settings` value split by newlines. There is no `quote`/escaping or bind params, so a host line containing `'` will break the SQL (or worse). Additionally, because this is a raw INSERT it bypasses the `EmbeddableHost` model’s `before_validation` trimming, so legacy values that include schemes/paths/CRLF (e.g. `http://...` or `...\r`) can be persisted verbatim and then fail later matching in `record_for_host` (which compares `lower(host)` to the parsed URI host).
